summary: Canadian Natural Resources Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results from its annual and special meeting of shareholders held May 7, 2026. The filing discloses that 12 director nominees were elected with votes ranging from 91.40% to 99.87% approval, and that shareholders ratified the appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as auditor and approved an advisory say-on-pay resolution. No special-situation transaction, management change event, or strategic action is detailed. Accordingly, this is a routine earnings or governance update and does not qualify as a special situation.
